authoritative.note: 人工精选的 AI 里程碑论文，不按时间限制；以原始论文、官方会议页或 Nature 页面为准。

items.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate

items.why: Dropout 的代表性论文，是神经网络正则化的经典方法。

items.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

items.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
items.why: GPT-3 展示规模扩展与少样本学习的涌现能力。

items.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models

items.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback

items.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
items.why: Chinchilla 重新定义模型规模与训练 token 的配比。

items.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
items.why: 系统说明开放基础模型与对话模型的训练、评测和安全策略。

items.why: MoE 大模型的高效训练与推理代表工作，对低成本大模型路线影响显著。

items.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
items.why: 以强化学习激发推理能力的代表性工作，推动推理模型成为研究热点。

items.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report
items.why: 覆盖多尺寸、多语言与长上下文能力的开放模型技术报告。

items.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.why: 提出思维链提示，显著提升大模型的复杂推理能力。

items.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
items.why: 将推理与工具行动结合，是 AI Agent 的核心基础论文之一。

items.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
items.why: 展示语言模型自主调用外部工具的可行路径。

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
items.why: 提出 RAG，成为知识增强、搜索问答和企业知识库的基础方法。

items.title: Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model
items.why: DPO 简化偏好对齐流程，成为 RLHF 之外的重要对齐方法。

items.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
items.why: 提出基于原则与 AI 反馈的安全对齐框架。

items.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
items.why: 低秩微调方法，大幅降低大模型适配与部署成本。

items.why: 重构注意力计算的显存与速度路径，成为长上下文训练基础设施。

items.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
items.why: 推动稀疏 MoE 架构在大模型中的规模化应用。

items.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
items.why: 以选择性状态空间挑战 Transformer 的长序列计算瓶颈。

items.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
items.why: DDPM 奠定现代扩散生成模型的理论与训练基础。

items.title: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
items.why: 证明扩散模型在图像生成质量上可以超越 GAN。

items.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
items.why: Latent Diffusion/Stable Diffusion 的基础论文，推动高质量图像生成普及。

items.why: ViT 证明 Transformer 可以成为通用视觉主干网络。

items.title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
items.why: 展示少样本视觉语言模型的跨模态推理能力。

items.title: Segment Anything
items.why: SAM 推动通用图像分割与视觉基础模型的发展。

items.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
items.why: 3DGS 以实时高质量渲染推动三维重建与生成式 3D 发展。

items.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.why: NeRF 开创神经辐射场，成为三维视觉与场景重建的重要基础。

items.why: AlphaFold 2 解决长期困扰生物学的蛋白质结构预测难题。

items.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search
items.why: AlphaGo 是深度强化学习与复杂博弈结合的里程碑。

hot.note: Hugging Face Daily Papers 近 21 天按点赞、评论与时效综合排序。

items.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
items.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, an…

items.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
items.summary: AscendGYM provides a benchmark for assessing kernel optimization capabilities on Ascend NPUs using real-workload test cases, two evaluation modes, and a Speedup-Token Score that balances speedup against token cost.

items.title: Jeveration: System One Models Now Generate
items.summary: Jeveration repurposes a frozen vision-language model to generate coherent images and perform image-to-image and dense prediction tasks in a single forward pass with fast 512x512 generation.

items.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
items.summary: When large language models write neural network weights without gradient-based training, they tend to design sparse table or associative-memory models that outperform same-sized Transformers with far fewer parameters and faster GPU inference, though pretrained LLMs remain more accurate.

items.title: Multi-Branch Transformer
items.summary: Branching Transformer blocks into parallel parameterized branches, combined with shared KV caching, improves language model quality and inference efficiency compared with standard sequential Transformers.

items.title: ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models
items.summary: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that l…

items.title: Beyond Answering: Learning to Speak First and Act in Streaming Video
items.summary: AURA 2.0 is a streaming video large language model that can initiate conversations, call tools, and perform interactive visual grounding, with long-horizon memory and a three-stage training scheme for improved streaming interaction.

items.title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
items.summary: A comprehensive benchmark evaluates time-series classification methods on a large clinical breath dataset under realistic temporal splits, showing that sensor drift lowers performance and recurrent models are most consistent across diseases.

items.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: Continual recursive self-improvement lets harness optimizers reuse and revise prior edits across changing benchmarks or policy models by storing rationales, predicted and observed outcomes, and evaluation contexts in a self-improvement memory, improving final scores over continuation baselines.

items.title: The Resolution Hypothesis: Agent Evolution's Key Is Identifying Improvements
items.summary: Agent evolution is often bottlenecked by noisy evaluations that cannot reliably identify better candidate artifacts or rank methods, so progress requires making true improvements detectable and accumulable.
